checkpoint_policy: every completed engine chunk and graceful exit; an interrupted chunk may be replayed from its saved start

rng.initial_seed_derivation: base_seed + global_worker_ordinal * 1000003; per-engine seed offset engine_index * 104729

sharing_policy: same target ID and exact matrix hash only; lexicographically fewer gates or equal gates with lower depth within recipient cap; engine states reset on adoption

matrix_source.kind: symbolic extraction from pinned official full S-box; no standalone NIST bottom matrix exists in the pinned tree

definition.output_bit_order: S0 is most significant AES output bit
definition.scope: Linear part only. Add the recorded affine output constants when reconnecting to the original nonlinear S-box.
